tasks.title: Source the gating inputs (RF2, exemplar pool, SME, domain slice)
tasks.rationale: RF2 licence, a bilingual pool, a committed SME, and a ~5k-concept domain gate everything downstream.

tasks.title: Curate the exemplar pool (declarative rules, new versioned CSV)
tasks.rationale: Reference data must not teach noise or superseded forms; curation is tracked, the raw pool is never edited.

tasks.title: Index exemplars (automatic on first use; vectors reuse across pool versions)
tasks.rationale: Per-concept retrieval needs the pool indexed; reuse makes re-curation cheap.

tasks.title: Seed the style guide (script/spacing/formatting only)
tasks.rationale: Editorial policy comes from SME rounds, not guesses.

tasks.title: Baseline cascade over the domain
tasks.rationale: Local sampling + escalation on disagreement; the disagreement signal doubles as review priority.

tasks.title: Detector sweep + QA gate on the baseline
tasks.rationale: One prioritised worklist from rules + hierarchy + duplicate-translation; blockers repaired before any pack ships.

tasks.title: Package round-1 review pack with a blinded stratified sample
tasks.rationale: The sample is the round's experiment — it measures whether priority predicts error. Pre-register the analysis.

tasks.title: SME reviews round 1 (sample + adjudication questions)
tasks.rationale: Rate every sample row including the fine ones; a handful of well-chosen questions settles many rows.

tasks.title: Ingest the returned round + measure tier separation
tasks.rationale: One tracked ingest run; then the pre-registered trend test across priority tiers.

tasks.title: Fold rulings in, deterministic first (rules -> guide -> pool -> gold merge)
tasks.rationale: Rulings become machine-checkable rules and prompt text; the gold merge applies supersession with a confirmation list.

tasks.title: Absorption test on the reviewed rows
tasks.rationale: Re-translate the same rows under the new configuration to measure feedback absorption before touching production.

tasks.title: Repair or re-translate, audit, package round 2
tasks.rationale: Minimal substitution for term defects; full re-translation for structural mass; pre-send audit with a high-confidence fix patch.

tasks.title: GEPA re-optimisation on the residue
tasks.rationale: After deterministic fold-ins saturate: leak-free split, SME-validated metric, rules frozen, promotion-gated.

tasks.title: Delivery gates + promote the deliverable
tasks.rationale: Blinded-sample error below target, zero unreviewed blockers, SME sign-off.

gates.description: Gating inputs sourced: RF2 licence, exemplar pool, SME commitment, domain slice
Baseline measured: cascade run + detector sweep recorded as tracked runs
Round-1 tier separation measured on the blinded sample (pre-registered analysis)
Optimised prompt beats the current guide on the held-out set (promotion gate)
